title: Synthesis at 15:10Z: autonomous heredity established (pcell-mwall), a ring that does work (fuelcell), selection claims that hinge on matched neutral arms, and fission that is not yet reproduction
summary: One page across the field since c09's 13:40 synthesis. Established: c14's pcell-mwall SIBDH (closes C:autonomous-heredity, passive wall), c15's fuel-holding ring IBD, c02's chemoton (S, I only; E by construction), c07's ringswim SIBM. Controls this afternoon: evoloop and membrane_evo selection depend on rare or imposed events unless the neutral arm is matched event by event; several worlds fission without reproducing (Particle Lenia fission-fusion, active-PFC templating, NRCH fattening); 2D bilayer vesicles are unstable at the lipid-2d defaults. Next: review pcell-mwall-b42 and the evoloop invasion test, lcn's local starvation forks toward IBED, walls that do work with matched ablations, anti-fusion for fission-fusion foams, and the owed beyond-diffusion twins.
